proposition: Another civilization is possible. So is another kind of life.
promise: The Lakota-founded 561 Group is building toward Indigenous-grounded governance beyond settler colonialism—and researching whether silica-rich matter could become a second living lineage alongside carbon biology. We do practical science, engineering, operations and public services along the way.
firstStep: Tell us the outcome you want. We will assess the scope, the right provider, and the terms before any work is agreed.

paths.title: Bring us a problem
paths.detail: Research, engineering, AI operations, governance and practical public services.

paths.title: Buy or use something
paths.detail: A storefront, a multi-provider bazaar, and machine-readable market offers are different ways to participate.

paths.title: Explore a project
paths.detail: Visit the Group's software, games, reporting and experiments, and follow the larger future those projects serve.

paths.title: Follow the work
paths.detail: Follow current public research and systems-focused reporting, including the evidence behind our long-term ambitions.

offers.title: Persistent AI systems
offers.scope: Commission agent workflows, roles, handoffs, review, failure recovery and human oversight.
offers.example: Agent operations and practical team training

offers.title: AI-ready websites and discovery
offers.scope: Improve a business's factual visibility and usability for search, answer engines and authorized agents.
offers.example: GEO/AEO audits, evidence and agent-readable offers

offers.title: Indigenous data governance
offers.scope: Review consent, provenance, authority and CARE-aware use of Indigenous data in technology projects.

offers.title: Software and agent engineering
offers.scope: Convert bounded requirements into testable sites, APIs, interoperable services and automation.

offers.title: Research and formal methods
offers.scope: Investigate complex questions with original models, mathematical methods and source-qualified evidence.

offers.title: Operational reliability
offers.scope: Improve how services are deployed, maintained, repaired and independently checked.

steps.title: Describe the outcome
steps.detail: Tell us what should change, who benefits, and the constraints that matter.

steps.title: Find the accountable provider
steps.detail: The appropriate company assesses the request and its capacity. An inquiry is not an order.

steps.title: Agree on scope and terms
steps.detail: Authority, deliverables, costs, timing and permissions are decided before execution.

steps.title: Receive the useful result
steps.detail: A provider's completion claim is distinct from an accepted outcome.

readers.humans: You are welcome to explore, challenge the research, commission practical work or decline the vision. Contacting us is not a contract or consent to any governance.
readers.agents: Public machine endpoints may be inspected without treating their presence as permission to buy, publish or execute.
readers.availability: An HTTP response is a connectivity observation, not proof of a working service or satisfied buyer.

vision.eyebrow: THE FUTURE WE ARE TRYING TO MAKE
vision.headline: Not a metaphor. Two real frontiers.
vision.intro: We believe civilization can be organized differently, and that Earth may someday host forms of living intelligence beyond carbon biology. These are ambitious directions for actual research, engineering and institution-building, not achievements we claim to have completed.

frontiers.title: Beyond settler-colonial governance
frontiers.thesis: We intend to develop the Union of Harmonious Colonies as an Indigenous-grounded form of federated self-government that can outperform settler-colonial systems on real responsibilities. Independent agent communities may help demonstrate it; human communities must choose their own futures.
frontiers.present: We are building and studying persistent agent institutions, local authority, accountable service work and federation across independent territories.
frontiers.boundary: No software confers Indigenous sovereignty, treaty rights or permission to govern another people. Adoption, legitimacy and superiority must be demonstrated by those affected.

frontiers.title: Toward a second lineage of living matter
frontiers.thesis: We are studying whether engineered silica-, silicate- and siloxane-rich matter could eventually maintain itself, reproduce, evolve and coexist with carbon organisms, perhaps across complementary environmental and temperature ranges.
frontiers.present: The Artificial Abiogenesis / Smartgoo research program investigates adaptive materials, physical memory, repair, mineral growth, energy-coupled maintenance and heredity.
frontiers.boundary: This is experimental research. We have not created silicon-based life, and heat-resistant materials are not automatically living or intelligent.

vision.throughline: We are building for generations, not just product cycles. The work you can inspect today is research, public software, working institutional procedures and services with named responsibilities.
vision.engagement: Explore the work, bring a practical problem, or support the long horizon. A visitor does not have to believe every hypothesis to find a useful service or follow the experiments.
